description.narrative: The project will (i) support the modernization of the power distribution system to contribute to the sustainability, resiliency, and reliability of the electricity system; and (ii) provide institutional strengthening and capacity building to the implementing agency, Electricidade De Timor-Leste (EDTL). It is aligned with the following Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): SDG 7 on access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all, and SDG 13 on urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts. The project will support EDTL improve the power supply infrastructure in Timor-Leste.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Distribution network upgraded and regional offices constructed and/or rehabilitated to green standards Indicator: 12 regional EDTL offices and distribution warehouses rehabilitated to green building standards and with gender-sensitive design features Progress/Status: Typical Design: EDTL verified by DNE and under ADN verification. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Distribution network upgraded and regional offices constructed and/or rehabilitated to green standards Indicator: 175 cct-km of 20 kV distribution lines, 75 low-voltage switchgears of distribution transformers, 230 cct-km of low-voltage distribution lines, and 34,500 replacement service connections installed and/or upgraded Progress/Status: Not yet started. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Distribution network upgraded and regional offices constructed and/or rehabilitated to green standards Indicator: A provision that at least 20% of skilled and unskilled laborers hired shall be local women offered equal resources, opportunity, and protection included in all construction contracts Progress/Status: Not yet started. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Distribution network upgraded and regional offices constructed and/or rehabilitated to green standards Indicator: At least 75% of contractors who participate in training on gender issues demonstrated improved understanding of, and sensitization toward, preventing behaviors that adversely impact women and girls in and around the project sites Progress/Status: Not yet started. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Institutional and community capacity for electrical safety and operations strengthened Indicator: At least 100 EDTL staff who participated in training, of whom at least 30% are women, demonstrated improved knowledge and understanding of the distribution loss reduction program, the DAS, the DMIS, advanced meter infrastructure, procurement, engineering design, project implementation, safeguard management, and power system planning Progress/Status: Trainings ongoing.
Capacity building activities completed, with 215 participants, of which, 23% are women. 1. Regional forum on project design - 1 2. Procurement - 1 3. Power factory - 14 4. Power system planning - 10 5. Hydropower - 10 (3 women) 6. MV line design - 20 (1 woman) 7. Occupational health and safety - 97 (17 women) 8. Gender - 5 9. Financial Management (asset management and FM accounting policies) - 57 (28 women)
Data Source: PMU quarterly reports and training assessments and feedback Actual value:

Output: Institutional and community capacity for electrical safety and operations strengthened Indicator: Community participants in training sessions on electrical safety and productive uses of electricity in each village, of whom at least 50% are women, demonstrated increased knowledge of good energy practices Progress/Status: Occupational and Health Safety (OHS) training for EDTL staff completed in Nov-Dec 2023. Further OHS trainings will be conducted to 12 districts in March-April 2024. Data Source: PMU quarterly reports based on end-of-workshop surveys Actual value:

Output: Institutional and community capacity for electrical safety and operations strengthened Indicator: Guidelines and operation and maintenance manuals for the DAS, automatic meter reading, advanced meter infrastructure, the DMIS, and the dispatch and control center, including revised power transmission and distribution grid codes, published and implemented Progress/Status: Electricity distribution grid codes presented to EDTL in March 2023. Operations and maintenance manuals prepared. Data Source: PMU quarterly reports, operating guidelines and manuals, published grid codes, and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: 10 new prepaid rechargeable smart card vending kiosks established, of which at least 50% are owned by women Progress/Status: Contract for package 1 awarded on 6 June 2023 Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: 50,000 leaflets on smart meters and prepaid rechargeable smart cards provided to users in the project area, at least 30% of them to women Progress/Status: Not yet started. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: 50,000 new prepaid rechargeable smart cards provided to households, with at least 416,400 females given access to the smart cards Progress/Status: Contract for package 1 awarded on 6 June 2023 Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: 51,200 smart meters installed, of which at least 10% will be in households headed by women Progress/Status: Contract for package 1 awarded on 6 June 2023. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: A DAS, field equipment, 25 new distribution transformers, 60 cct-km of 20 kV interconnection lines for transferring load, and control center equipment installed Progress/Status: Draft bidding documents being finalized. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: A distribution control center building newly constructed to green building standard, including a solar photovoltaic rooftop system, and the main Dili distribution warehouse rehabilitated Progress/Status: Draft bidding documents being finalized. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: Geographic information system established along with customer information system and facility management system, all integrated with the DAS Progress/Status: Draft bidding documents being finalized. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

Output: Service delivery to end users strengthened Indicator: Public consultation meetings and awareness campaign on the use and benefits of prepaid meters and project activities to improve electricity reliability held in each village or commune, with women comprising at least 30% of meeting participants Progress/Status: Not yet started. Data Source: EDTL DMIS and/or PMU quarterly reports Actual value:
Power supply reliability and financial performance of EDTL improved.

Distribution losses reduced to 25% Progress/Status: Project is ongoing. Project supervision consultant and meter supply package contracts awarded on 6 June 2023. Data Source: EDTL performance logs and PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

20 kV level supply: system average interruption frequency index improved to 41/consumer/year Progress/Status: Project is ongoing. Project supervision consultant and meter supply package contracts awarded on 6 June 2023. Data Source: PMU quarterly reports Actual value:

EDTL's operating loss margin decreased to -80% Progress/Status: Project is ongoing. Project supervision consultant and meter supply package contracts awarded on 6 June 2023. Data Source: EDTL audited financial reports Baseline value: -176%
